notes: Killcam: the gun is now driven by a per-frame recording of the real gun's parts, so weapon swaps, reloads, inspects, aim and recoil replay exactly as they happened; duplicate hands fixed (the game re-enabled them every frame); inputs frozen while watching a killcam alive and stuck fire/aim inputs cleared afterwards. Weapon skins now actually glow: gun materials are swapped for lit-shader copies with the original texture plus tint and emission (the game's own shaders had no emission), restored when the match ends.
